class.name: DisEntityStateUpdatePdu
class.brief_description: Entity State Update PDU (type 67): the changing part of an Entity State PDU.
class.description: An Entity State Update PDU carries only the fields of an entity that change often: linear velocity, location, orientation, appearance and variable parameters. Entity type, marking and dead reckoning parameters are left out; the receiver knows them from an earlier [DisEntityStatePdu]. It is 72 bytes plus 16 per variable parameter and has protocol family 1 (Entity Information). [DisEntityManager] applies it through [method DisEntityManager.handle_entity_state_update], which is connected to [signal DisNetwork.entity_state_update_received] automatically. The PDU is encoded with godot-dis's own code.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as an Entity State Update PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Entity State Update PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 72 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].

members.member: Appearance bit field (32-bit, entity-type specific, see SISO-REF-010). A deactivated appearance makes [DisEntityManager] remove the entity.
ID of the entity the update is for, as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).
Velocity of the entity in metres per second, in geocentric (ECEF) axes (32-bit floats on the wire).

Location of the entity in WGS84 geocentric (ECEF) coordinates, as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][x, y, z][/code] in metres. Setting an array that does not have exactly 3 values prints an error and leaves the old value.
Orientation of the entity as DIS Euler angles in radians: [code]x[/code] = psi (heading), [code]y[/code] = theta (pitch), [code]z[/code] = phi (roll) (32-bit floats on the wire).
Variable parameter records as an [Array] of [PackedByteArray]. Each entry is exactly 16 bytes (articulation or attached part records) and is kept raw. At most 255 records are allowed.
